android_fork_merge.notes: Deep sync of the fork with upstream horizon-rust/horizon:main as of 2026-11-15. The fork keeps: Compose/JNI launcher, ARM64 Rust build with the Android touch stack, .hmod/.hnmod native-mod pipeline, Android renderer preparation machinery (deferred background renderer build, recreate_surface on resume, GL-blocking guards), per-instance presets. Upstream's crate split (horizon-client-lib, horizon-hooks, horizon-official, horizon-optifine, etc.) and NATIVE_HOOKS_API 645 are ADOPTED; fork's native_hooks.rs continues to assert the fork's base set on top; AppleSkin's 139 hooks should now build. Deployment workflows remain disabled under .github/upstream-workflows/.

review: Deep-sync merge performed 2026-11-15 on sync/horizon-main-2026-11-14 (158 files changed, 13,492 insertions / 23,767 deletions, two-parent merge commit). Conflict resolution done without a local compiler (tablet cannot run cargo); every merged .rs file was passed through rustfmt (edition 2024) to catch delimiter drift, and the tree contains zero conflict markers; .githooks/pre-commit hooks pass (check_public_tree). Fork-only ARM64 APK compile and source checks are delegated to GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/android-dev.yml and android-source.yml); the focused PR is against `android`. Behaviour claimed only after CI: Compose launcher keeps connection state, menu/button layout, Android logcat output, long-press/scroll gestures, swipe-to-quit, IME handling, DS-controller/Android KeyMapper/press-to-toggle, .hmod content + .hnmod native-mod loading paths unchanged. No behavioural claims beyond what CI verifies.
